paper_title: ADMX SLIC: Results from a Superconducting LC Circuit Investigating Cold Axions
notes: ADMX SLIC LC-circuit haloscope search for axions in three narrow mass windows near 1.75-1.80e-7 eV (42-43 MHz). Abstract states exclusion for coupling below 1e-12 GeV^-1. Exact per-mass coupling values are only shown in Fig. 4 (not machine-readable in provided text), so I approximated the limit as ~1e-12 GeV^-1 across the searched mass windows quoted in text. Numerical y-values from the figure are not available, hence low extraction confidence.
